USB-C Wall Adapter(1)100W USB-C CableSpecsLoadingManualsParts ListProduct OverviewOur M18™ TOP-OFF™ Charger and Power Supply is the most compact M18™ battery charger, up to 65% smaller than traditional kitted chargers, offering a portable solution for charging Milwaukee Tool M18™ batteries. It features advanced USB-C PD technology for faster headlamps, phones, tablets, and laptop charging. It includes a 100W USB-C cord and a 65W wall charger, with dual USB-C ports for small electronics and larger devices. Compatible with all M18™ batteries, it can charge a phone up to five times with an M18™ XC 5.0 Battery. Recharging the M18™ XC 5.0 Battery takes approximately 105 minutes with a 65W wall charger.Fits All M18™ BatteriesHas (1) 100W PD port (1) 15W portIncludes: 1 charger (100W), 1 cable (100W) & 1 wall adaptor (65W)115W Continuous PowerIdeal for headlamps, cellphones, tablet and computersLightweight, Compact Design5-Year Tool WarrantyProduct DocumentsManual / Parts ListPN0004810ReviewsAdditional ResourcesManualsWarrantyParts ListFix My ToolExplore the systems2847-20M18™ TOP-OFF™ Charger & Power SupplyShare© 2026 by Milwaukee Tool.
